name: @sps/desktop
description: SPS Desktop Owner Host and Member Node collaboration app
author: SonParkServer

scripts.prestart: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk
scripts.predev: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk
scripts.pretest: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk
scripts.test:e2e:bootstrap: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-isolated-desktop-ui.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:native-identity-storage: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-native-identity-storage.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:core-settings: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --corrupt-recovery && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --corrupt-desktop-state && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --unwritable-desktop-state && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --malformed-routing-state && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --malformed-native-member-index && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --unverified-legacy-adoption && node scripts/smoke-core-settings-desktop.mjs --deferred-owner
scripts.test:e2e:workspace-surfaces: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-workspace-surfaces-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:execution-control: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-workspace-surfaces-desktop.mjs --execution-control
scripts.test:e2e:no-ai-checklist: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-workspace-surfaces-desktop.mjs --no-ai-checklist
scripts.test:e2e:native-management: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-workspace-surfaces-desktop.mjs --native-management
scripts.test:e2e:runtime-discovery: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-workspace-surfaces-desktop.mjs --runtime-discovery
scripts.test:e2e:plugin-preview: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-plugin-preview-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:plugin-preview:live: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-plugin-preview-desktop.mjs --live-authoring
scripts.test:e2e:plugin-preview:team: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-plugin-preview-desktop.mjs --live-team
scripts.test:e2e:host-plugin-lifecycle: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-host-plugin-lifecycle-desktop.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:host-plugin-lifecycle:live: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/smoke-host-plugin-lifecycle-desktop.mjs --live-agent
scripts.prepare:owner-host-runtime: npm run sync:desktop-node && npm run sync:plugin-sdk && node scripts/prepare-owner-host-runtime.mjs
scripts.package:win: npm run release:clean-evidence && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy && npm run prepare:owner-host-runtime && electron-builder --win nsis && node scripts/write-update-metadata.mjs && npm run stage:agent-runtime-packs && npm run archive:agent-runtime-packs && npm run verify:packaged-owner-host-runtime && node scripts/create-release-manifest.mjs && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy
scripts.release:win: npm run release:clean-evidence && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy && npm run prepare:owner-host-runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --config.forceCodeSigning=true --publish never && node scripts/write-update-metadata.mjs && npm run stage:agent-runtime-packs && npm run archive:agent-runtime-packs && npm run verify:packaged-owner-host-runtime && node scripts/create-release-manifest.mjs && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy
scripts.package:candidate:win: npm run release:clean-evidence && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy && npm run prepare:owner-host-runtime && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never && node scripts/write-update-metadata.mjs && npm run stage:agent-runtime-packs && npm run archive:agent-runtime-packs && npm run verify:packaged-owner-host-runtime && node scripts/create-release-manifest.mjs && npm run release:verify-evidence-privacy
